verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central add-on offers an API discovery tool, self-service documentation, use-case templates, generated code samples and "code collection samples" via ADP Assist. Nothing shows an interactive reference where examples can be run in-browser, and API Central is a separately purchased add-on rather than core RUN. Missing for 10: a documented interactive/try-it API console, evidence that examples are runnable rather than just generated code, RUN-specific API reference coverage, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
